caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a lamp base, rendered in grayscale tones with graphite or pencil on an off-white background. The lamp base has a vertically-oriented, symmetrical structure, with a tall, faceted central section that tapers slightly toward the bottom and widens again toward the top, ending in a threaded neck intended to hold a fixture. Below the central section are several rounded, disk-like elements stacked vertically, transitioning into a more ornate, square base. The base features sculpted decorative elements resembling scrollwork or carved detailing and rests flat at the bottom. The entire object is drawn with shading to suggest three-dimensional volume, and the background is left blank, placing all focus on the base itself.
title: Lamp
